severe_examples.word:coax: Current learner Core is the coaxial-cable noun; the high-frequency gentle-persuasion verb exists only behind it.
severe_examples.word:complementary: Current preserves only the logic-negation technical sense and misses ordinary completing/enhancing compatibility.
severe_examples.word:contagion: Current keeps only figurative emotional spread and omits infectious-disease contagion as the ordinary branch.
severe_examples.word:culmination: Current is astronomy-only and omits the ordinary final/highest/resulting point.
severe_examples.word:cult: Current bakes unorthodox/extremist/false evaluation into Core instead of using context-sensitive group/system semantics.
severe_examples.word:demise: Current is a legal transfer-by-lease/will verb and omits the modern noun death/end.
severe_examples.word:derelict: Current foregrounds a homeless-person noun and duty failure while missing the common abandoned/neglected-property adjective.
severe_examples.word:enact: Current contains only acting/performing and omits enact a law/legislation.
severe_examples.word:eulogy: Current restricts eulogy to praise for someone who died recently; the useful Core is formal praise, often but not definitionally only funerary.

review_notes.semantic_family_but_surface_missing: Most partial rows already contain the relevant lexical meaning but lack the controlled construction/collocation, e.g. coax sb into doing, conducive to, confide in, construe A as B, detract from, devoid of, digress from, dwindle to, encroach on/upon, engrossed in, equivocate on/about, expound on.
review_notes.wrong_anchor_or_incomplete_family: Partial rows also include cases with useful evidence on the wrong POS/branch or only one half of the family, e.g. charitable interpretation, collate data/results, conjure up, emotional/financial contagion, decipher handwriting/code, dilate pupils, dodge a question, dispensable/indispensable, exasperated by.

fresh_semantic_judgments.latest: Current already exposes loud insistent demand/outcry across verb and noun; no new Core sense is needed.
Preserve royal spouse noun plus formal associate/keep-company verb; Current already carries both.
Current already includes the precise low-pressure rotating-air meteorological branch in addition to the ordinary rotating-storm reading; do not collapse it into tornado.
Skillful and coordinated in physical movement, especially the hands, is already the correct learner Core.
Core is impartial/free from self-interest; keep uninterested confusion as a Relation boundary rather than changing this Core.
Compress around giving/helping and kind or generous judgment; retain charitable interpretation as a useful extension instead of three near-duplicate generosity senses.
Use sexually abstinent/not engaging in sexual activity plus restrained/simple style; avoid moralizing the Core as unlawful sex.
Preserve human settlement/colonial control with neutral historical wording and add the biological establish/populate-a-host-or-habitat branch.
Use a small/intensely devoted religious or social group/system with context-sensitive negative connotation; do not define false/extremist as an intrinsic lexical condition.
Lead with abandoned/neglected property or serious neglect of duty; the homeless-person noun is dated/disparaging and must not lead.
Lead with an authoritarian ruler exercising largely unchecked power; dictating to a secretary/recorder is historical/low-value.
A eulogy is formal praise, commonly delivered for someone who has died but not definitionally restricted to a recently deceased person.
Direct-pass calibration upgrade: weaken or drain energy/vitality, not merely weaken mentally or morally.
Direct-pass calibration upgrade: eradicate/destroy completely, especially pests or a targeted population, not simply kill many.
